All deliverables are in place. The v1.2 repair round is complete.

## Summary

I fixed all three checker items in the PAPER_K7 implementation, confined to `regression.py` and `pipeline.py`, and accepted every item as valid (none was judged mistaken).

**Checker item 1 (amendment A5/A10, degrees-of-freedom ordering).** In `regression.py`, `_check_non_dummy_columns` no longer raises a residual-degrees-of-freedom error during dummy resolution. A rank-deficient non-dummy design, including one with no more rows than non-dummy columns, is now reported with its all-zero or collinear reason. The residual-df check is left to `fit_linear`, which runs after the permitted industry-dummy drops. This covers reported models, nested restricted models, and every influence refit.

**Checker item 2 (amendment A6, influence rows).** In `pipeline.py`, a failed original model now produces exactly one influence row per estimation-sample record with an empty term, via the new `_orig_failed_row`, instead of one row per record per term. An empty estimation sample yields no influence row, only the failure entry in the run info. Per-deletion failures inside a successful model still list every term.

**Checker item 3 (specification section 6, parameter counts).** When dummy resolution succeeds but the fit then fails, `run_spec` now reports the parameter count and the number of industry dummies from the resolved column names. They stay missing only when resolution itself failed or the sample was empty.

**Tests.** I added `code/tests/test_v1_2.py` with 16 tests covering the three items plus HC3 with a leverage-one row and copy-rule validity, and updated two superseded v1.1 assertions in place. All 91 tests across six files pass.

**Grid run.** The full grid ran on the synthetic data into `code/dev_out/v1_2/`: 38 specs, 32 recorded failures, all the known D05 empty-sample artefact. Every failure there is an empty sample, so the counts are missing in that output and the item-3 path is exercised by the unit tests instead. Synthetic results were not interpreted.

**Docs.** I added a "v1.2 changes" section to `code/README.md` describing each amendment item and checker item, flagged the superseded v1.1 passages, and wrote `code/DONE_v1_2.txt`.

One note: the amendment file is still `spec_amendment_v1_1.md`, so I bumped only the implementation version to v1.2, not the amendment reference.
